name: Minowa Touko
source:
She has been married for 8 years and is a housewife.

She is a former designer and for a while she continued to work after marriage. Both her parents and in-laws kept asking when she is going to have a baby, she could not win against their nagging and gave birth to her first child, Koutarou.

Her husband was very supportive in the beginning, but as the months went by, his enthusiasm cooled down, now he leaves all the household chores, including childcare, to her.

She also believes that her husband is having an affair.

She is not too pessimistic about the situation and says, "Well, I don't care what I have to do, as long as he brings home some money for Koutarou. However, if Koutarou's happiness is threatened, she turns into a demon.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=540985&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
